star-recovery-backup.service:
[Unit]
Description=Pull an encrypted STAR backup from Brain 1

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 %h/.local/share/star-recovery/bin/recovery_backup.py --config %h/.config/star-recovery/starai.json backup
TimeoutStartSec=30min
KillMode=control-group
UMask=0077
Nice=15
CPUWeight=20
IOWeight=20
NoNewPrivileges=yes
star-recovery-backup.timer:
[Unit]
Description=Hourly STAR recovery points

[Timer]
OnBootSec=3min
OnCalendar=*-*-* *:10:00 UTC
Persistent=true
RandomizedDelaySec=60s
AccuracySec=30s

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
star-recovery-verify.service:
[Unit]
Description=Restore and verify STAR backup checksums and databases

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 %h/.local/share/star-recovery/bin/recovery_backup.py --config %h/.config/star-recovery/starai.json verify
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 %h/.local/share/star-recovery/bin/recovery_backup.py --config %h/.config/star-recovery/starai.json baseline
TimeoutStartSec=30min
KillMode=control-group
UMask=0077
Nice=15
CPUWeight=20
IOWeight=20
NoNewPrivileges=yes
star-recovery-verify.timer:
[Unit]
Description=Daily full STAR backup restore check

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 07:35:00 UTC
Persistent=true
RandomizedDelaySec=60s
AccuracySec=30s

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
star-recovery-retention.service:
[Unit]
Description=Compact rolling STAR backups while preserving the separate baseline

[Service]

ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 %h/.local/share/star-recovery/bin/recovery_backup.py --config %h/.config/star-recovery/starai.json retention
TimeoutStartSec=30min

UMask=0077
Nice=15
CPUWeight=20
IOWeight=20
NoNewPrivileges=yes
star-recovery-retention.timer:
[Unit]
Description=Daily STAR backup retention

[Timer]

Persistent=true
RandomizedDelaySec=60s
AccuracySec=30s

[Install]
